contract.name: API contract
contract.section.title: API contract
contract.section.desc: Compares the backend swagger with the API calls in the client repositories and lets you browse the endpoints. Read-only: nothing is sent and nothing is written.
contract.section.enableDesc: Adds the API contract tab and a badge on Changes tree files that contain API calls. Nothing is loaded or scanned while this is off.
contract.heuristic: Heuristic check: calls are found by reading source text, so dynamic paths and unusual helpers can be missed or misread. Every finding shows how sure it is.
contract.noSpecDesc: None of the workspace repositories has a swagger or openapi file, or yaml fragments under src/api.
contract.specLine: {kind} {version} from {repo}: {endpoints, plural, one {# endpoint} other {# endpoints}}, {definitions, plural, one {# definition} other {# definitions}}
contract.clientLine: {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
contract.cachedTip: Nothing changed in this repository since the last scan: served from the cache for its commit and working tree.
contract.filter.search: Filter by call, file or name
contract.heuristicTip: A best-effort guess from source text, not a certainty.
contract.msg.renamed: {target} is not in the swagger. It may have been renamed.
contract.msg.method: {target}: the swagger allows {allowed} on this path.
contract.msg.tagMismatch: {target}: the operation exists, but under the tag {tags}.
contract.msg.requiredParam: {target} does not send the required {count, plural, one {parameter} other {parameters}} {names}.
contract.msg.responseField: The response schema of {target} has no {count, plural, one {field} other {fields}} {names}, which this code reads.
contract.msg.deprecated: {target} is marked deprecated in the swagger.
contract.suggest: Closest in the swagger: {endpoint} ({similarity, number, percent} similar)
contract.openSuggestion: Open swagger path of the suggestion
contract.nothingDesc: Every call the scan found matches the swagger.
contract.nothingFilteredDesc: Clear a filter to see the rest.
contract.findingsCount: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}
contract.unused.title: Swagger endpoints that no client calls
contract.unused.note: Based on the calls the scan found. An endpoint reached only through a dynamic path appears here too.
contract.unused.shown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Refine the search to see more.
contract.unused.noneDesc: At least one client call matches each endpoint in the swagger.
contract.explorer.shown: Showing {shown} of {total}. Refine the search to see more.
contract.explorer.pickDesc: Browse the backend contract. Examples are generated from the schema.
contract.detail.exampleNote: Generated from the schema, not from a real response.
contract.detail.notUsed: No client call matches this endpoint.
contract.curl.copiedBody: Placeholders stand in for the token and every id.
contract.curl.note: Placeholders stand in for the token and the ids. Nothing is sent: the explorer is read-only.
contract.badge: {calls, plural, one {# API call} other {# API calls}}
contract.badgeProblems: {calls, plural, one {# API call} other {# API calls}}, {problems, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}}
